sources.title: Set up the Navigation SDK for Android
supported_findings: Requires a billing-enabled Cloud project.
Enable navigationsdk.googleapis.com.
The API restriction label is Navigation SDK for Android; selecting a restriction does not itself enable the service.
Android application restrictions use package name and signing-certificate SHA-1.

sources.title: Google Maps Platform core services pricing list
supported_findings: Global USD first paid tiers per 1000 billable events: Navigation Request free cap 1000 then 25 USD; Autocomplete Requests cap 10000 then 2.83 USD; Place Details Essentials cap 10000 then 5 USD.
Autocomplete Session Usage is unlimited no-charge for that SKU, not the whole workflow.
Place Details Enterprise + Atmosphere cap 1000 then 25 USD, relevant only to the older 0.1.0 field/session analysis.
Usage is aggregated across projects linked to the billing account.

sources.title: Google Maps Platform pricing overview
supported_findings: On March 1 2025 per-SKU free usage caps replaced the general 200 USD monthly credit.
Free usage resets monthly at the beginning of the month in US Pacific time.
The tutorial uses global pay-as-you-go prices, not India pricing or a separately purchased subscription.

sources.title: Navigation SDK overview and requirements
supported_findings: Navigation SDK replaces Maps SDK for map and navigation features; they must not both be included in one app.
Device needs Google Play services, at least 2 GB RAM, and OpenGL ES 2.0.
Actual current body specifies API 24 minimum and API 36 target for SDK 7+; the companion itself sets minimum API 26.

sources.title: Google Maps Platform security guidance
supported_findings: Apply both application and API restrictions.
Android restrictions use application package and signing-certificate SHA-1.
Use keys appropriate to the app and protect, rotate, or revoke compromised credentials.

sources.title: Android: Sign your app
supported_findings: Debug, release and Play App Signing certificates can differ.
Use the actual app signing certificate, not the upload certificate, when configuring installed-app identity.
Signing report can disclose certificate fingerprints without disclosing private signing keys.

sources.title: Getting started with Google Maps Platform
supported_findings: Create/select a Cloud project, enable billing, and enable needed products.
Keep the project used for services and API credentials consistent.

sources.title: Free Google Cloud features and trial offer
supported_findings: Eligible new customers may have a 300 USD, 90-day trial.
Eligibility, remaining credit and actual expiration must be checked in the user account.
Paid-account usage beyond applicable credits/free allowances may be billed; unupgraded expired trial can stop resources.

sources.title: Set up the Places SDK for Android
supported_findings: Places SDK depends on Places API (New), service places.googleapis.com.
The API restriction label is Places API (New).
Setting the restriction does not enable the service.
Allow a few minutes after enabling services or changing settings.

sources.title: Places SDK Legacy overview and feature comparison
supported_findings: New Autocomplete requires Places Android 3.5.0 or later; New Details requires 3.3.0 or later.
initializeWithNewPlacesApiEnabled selects the New service; the companion already uses this API.
A 3.5.0 dependency alone does not imply Legacy usage.

sources.title: Place Details Legacy
supported_findings: Current page states that as of October 2026 Places API Legacy cannot be newly enabled for new projects.
March 1 2025 was the broader Legacy designation date, not the cutoff date to substitute for this statement.

sources.title: Navigation SDK for Android Usage and Billing
supported_findings: Navigation Request is billed per requested destination or waypoint.
After a destination is fetched, starting guidance and traffic/road closure/off-route adjustments do not add this destination fee.
NO_ROUTE_FOUND and ROUTE_CANCELED are billable; several network, location and client failures are not.
Navigation quotas and pricing units should be distinguished.

sources.title: Autocomplete New and session pricing
supported_findings: With a valid session ending in Place Details Essentials, first 12 Autocomplete requests bill as Autocomplete Requests and subsequent requests as no-charge Session Usage; terminating Details is billed separately.
Incomplete sessions or invalid/expired tokens revert to per-request Autocomplete billing.
Terminating a session with Pro or higher Details fields invokes the Enterprise + Atmosphere session ending rule.
IDs-only ending has different rules and should not be confused with coordinate-bearing Essentials ending.

sources.title: Place Data Fields New
supported_findings: ID is an IDs-only field; location and formatted address are Essentials; display name is Pro.
In Places SDK 3.5.0 the corresponding older names include LAT_LNG, ADDRESS and NAME.
The final companion 0.1.1 requests ID and LAT_LNG only and retains prediction labels.

sources.title: Places New SKU details
supported_findings: Details field masks bill at the highest requested field SKU, subject to the session ending rules.
Autocomplete first-12/Session Usage behavior is explicitly described.
Old NAME corresponds to DISPLAY_NAME; this supports the reason to remove it from the 0.1.1 Details request.

sources.title: Create edit or delete budgets and alerts
supported_findings: Alerts-only budgets notify; they do not automatically cap Navigation or Places spending.
Budgets can scope project and alert thresholds; the reader must verify notification recipients.

sources.title: Manage spend cap budgets
supported_findings: Current eligible-product list includes Gemini API, Agent Platform, Cloud Run and Cloud Run functions.
Navigation and Places are not on that list, so a Maps project budget cannot be represented as a hard spending cap.
Even applicable spend caps have limitations and are not instantaneous.

sources.title: Manage Google Maps Platform costs
supported_findings: Daily quota, where supported, limits usage and resets at Pacific midnight.
Per-minute rates are not daily or monthly spending caps.
Quota units and billable units may differ; leave headroom and account for other usage.
Billing data may take up to 48 hours to appear.

sources.title: Places SDK for Android Usage and Billing
supported_findings: Places New quotas apply per API method per project.
Field selections and session handling affect billing.
Each valid session should use a unique token and end appropriately.

sources.title: NavigationApi ErrorCode
supported_findings: NOT_AUTHORIZED=1; TERMS_NOT_ACCEPTED=2; NETWORK_ERROR=3; LOCATION_PERMISSION_MISSING=4.
Successful local key saving is not an authorization response.

sources.title: PlacesStatusCodes
supported_findings: 9010 OVER_QUERY_LIMIT; 9011 REQUEST_DENIED; 9012 INVALID_REQUEST; 9013 NOT_FOUND.
This corrects the old 0.1.0 UI mislabeling 9010 as network failure.

sources.title: Navigation SDK coverage
supported_findings: Taiwan row supports basic navigation categories.
Taiwan Speed Limits, Traffic Lights and Stop Signs, and Real-Time Disruptions are dash entries.
Dash means unavailable or low quality/availability; do not promise consumer Google Maps features are exposed by the SDK.

sources.title: Android apksigner
supported_findings: apksigner verify --verbose --print-certs reports APK signing-certificate information.

important_review_notes: Google official AI Page Summary text can be stale. The Navigation requirements summary says API 23/33 whereas current body says API 24/36; use actual body and the companion minSdk=26.
The Maps getting-started page summary still mentions 200 USD, whereas pricing overview and current pricing table show per-SKU caps; use pricing source actual body.
Maps FAQ was observed to say 91 days, while authoritative Cloud Free Program body says 90 days. Tutorial uses 90-day wording with actual account deadline authoritative.
Do not conflate March 2025 Legacy designation with the October 2026 new-project Legacy enablement cutoff.
App 0.1.1 cost categorization is based on ID/LAT_LNG source and Google documentation, not on a live user billing account. Actual SKU/session result must be checked after usage.

New signed 0.1.1 APK was still pending controlled signing when source review completed. The guide labels AD:32:96:3B:94:DF:5E:30:DB:1B:24:EC:D6:2B:B9:11:F8:8D:48:7E as the previously verified signer and tells users to copy actual installed App identity.
No Cloud project, billing account, paid subscription, API key or user payment information was created or edited in this task.
No actual user-key authorization, invoice or C4 road test was performed for this tutorial. Distance 180+260=440 is a contract example, not a road-test claim.
